{{Top|leg}}
A '''miniature transpirator''' was a more compact version of a [[Transpirator/Legends|transpirator]], small enough to fit on a [[survival tool]].

There was a miniature transpirator on the survival tool [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] made for [[Anakin Solo]], which Solo later gave to his [[Han Solo/Legends|father]] as a peace offering.
